				}
				mdr_space_refresh = yes
			}

				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdr_space_open } clr_country_flag = mdr_space_open }

					set_country_flag = mdr_space_open

			}
			mdr_pc_crew_on_click = {
				set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = mdr_pc_crew_view }
				mdr_space_refresh = yes
				ingame_update_setup = yes
			}
			mdr_pc_crew_off_click = {
				set_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed = 0 }
				mdr_space_refresh = yes
				ingame_update_setup = yes
			}
			mdr_pc_data_prev_click = {
				add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = -1 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view < 1 } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 4 } }
				add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
			}
			mdr_pc_data_next_click = {
				add_to_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 1 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view > 4 } } set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_view = 1 } }
				add_to_variable = { global.international_systems_updated = 1 }
			}
			mdr_pc_data_on_click = {
				set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = mdr_pc_data_view }
				mdr_space_refresh = yes
				ingame_update_setup = yes
			}
			mdr_pc_data_off_click = {
				set_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed = 0 }
				mdr_space_refresh = yes
				ingame_update_setup = yes
			}
		}

		triggers = {
			mdr_space_hq_up_click_enabled = {
				check_variable = { mdr_space_hq < 5 }
				check_variable = { var = mdr_space_science compare = greater_than_or_equals value = mdr_space_hq_science_cost }
				check_variable = { var = treasury compare = greater_than value = mdr_space_hq_money_cost }
			}
			mdr_pc_launch_on_visible = { NOT = { check_variable = { var = mdr_pc_launch_signed compare = equals value = mdr_pc_launch_view } } }
			mdr_pc_launch_on_click_enabled = { mdr_pc_launch_view_open = yes }
			mdr_pc_launch_off_visible = { check_variable = { var = mdr_pc_launch_signed compare = equals value = mdr_pc_launch_view } check_variable = { mdr_pc_launch_signed > 0 } }
			mdr_pc_sat_on_visible = { NOT = { check_variable = { var = mdr_pc_sat_signed compare = equals value = mdr_pc_sat_view } } }
			mdr_pc_sat_on_click_enabled = { mdr_pc_sat_view_open = yes }
			mdr_pc_sat_off_visible = { check_variable = { var = mdr_pc_sat_signed compare = equals value = mdr_pc_sat_view } check_variable = { mdr_pc_sat_signed > 0 } }
			mdr_pc_crew_on_visible = { NOT = { check_variable = { var = mdr_pc_crew_signed compare = equals value = mdr_pc_crew_view } } }
			mdr_pc_crew_on_click_enabled = { mdr_pc_crew_view_open = yes }
			mdr_pc_crew_off_visible = { check_variable = { var = mdr_pc_crew_signed compare = equals value = mdr_pc_crew_view } check_variable = { mdr_pc_crew_signed > 0 } }
			mdr_pc_data_on_visible = { NOT = { check_variable = { var = mdr_pc_data_signed compare = equals value = mdr_pc_data_view } } }
			mdr_pc_data_on_click_enabled = { mdr_pc_data_view_open = yes }
			mdr_pc_data_off_visible = { check_variable = { var = mdr_pc_data_signed compare = equals value = mdr_pc_data_view } check_variable = { mdr_pc_data_signed > 0 } }
		}

		dynamic_lists = {
			mdr_space_site_list = {
				array = mdr_space_site_states
				change_scope = yes
				entry_container = mdr_space_site_entry
			}
		}

			}
			mdr_space_go_missions_click = {

				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_cat_d = 4 } }
				mdr_space_refresh = yes
			}
			mdr_space_go_colonies_click = {
				set_variable = { mdr_space_page = 8 }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 5 } } set_variable = { mdr_space_colony_view = 2 } }
				else = { set_variable = { mdr_space_colony_view = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 4 } has_country_flag = mdr_col_moon } set_country_flag = mdr_moon_open }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 5 } has_country_flag = mdr_col_mars } set_country_flag = mdr_mars_open }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 2 } has_country_flag = mdr_col_venus } set_country_flag = mdr_venus_open }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 1 } has_country_flag = mdr_col_mercury } set_country_flag = mdr_mercury_open }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 6 } has_country_flag = mdr_col_asteroids } set_country_flag = mdr_asteroids_open }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 7 } has_country_flag = mdr_col_callisto } set_country_flag = mdr_callisto_open }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 8 } has_country_flag = mdr_col_titan } set_country_flag = mdr_titan_open }
				mdr_space_refresh = yes
			}
		}

			mdr_space_body_photo_1_visible = { check_variable = { mdr_space_body = 1 } }
